priceNote: Three lofts, right or left hand
buyBody: The second-generation Carver. A reshaped, more forgiving grind and a lower center of gravity, which is the difference you feel out of the lies that are not perfect. Three lofts, right or left hand, sixty days to decide.
whatYouGet: One Carver LGW02 Gold wedge in the loft and hand you picked
No headcover — none of our clubs ship with one
clubParas: The V2 exists because the first one was very good out of a clean lie and merely fine out of a bad one. The grind is reshaped and more forgiving, so the sole works through the turf instead of digging into it.
The center of gravity sits lower, which gets the ball up from lies that do not deserve it — hardpan, thin rough, the ones where a wedge normally punishes you.
It is forged, like the LGW01, so the feedback is the same honest kind. Where it differs is what happens when you do not catch it flush.

clubSpecs.v: Forged players' wedge, curated three-loft lineup.
Forged 1020 soft carbon steel. Same feedback as the LGW01.
CNC-milled grooves, micro-milled between, over a sandblasted finish.
Reshaped — sits cleaner behind the ball and slides rather than catches.
Softened grind for smoother turf interaction across more lies.
Anyone who wants the LGW01's feel and more help from imperfect lies.

videoBrief: 16:9 product film, 40–60s. Shot to show the grind: sole through turf in slow motion, then the same shot from a bad lie. The whole argument for this club is what happens when the lie is wrong.
specSub: Every number below is from the Product Reference Guide. Lie changes with loft on this club, which it does not on the LGW01.

specTabs.aside: The reference guide lists KBS Tour as the shaft. Cole confirmed 2026-07-31 that every wedge ships on the Lucky stock steel shaft today and KBS becomes a selectable upgrade — the documented exception where the guide is out of date.

look.photo: Bold, full-bleed, portrait. The gold head coming out of the bag in low sun, other players soft behind. Should stop the scroll on its own.
look.headline: You'll want to pull it out of the bag
paras: Most wedges are gray. This one is not, and you find out what that is worth the first time you take it out on a busy tee box.
That is not the reason to buy it — the grind is. But it is not nothing either.
look.aside: Everyone else is carrying the same club with someone else's name on it. It's better to be lucky.

closeBody: The LGW02 is $109 in every loft, right hand or left. Sixty days to send it back if it isn't the one.

helpLoft.headline: Start with the wedge you already carry
helpLoft.sub: Wedges work in gaps. Four to six degrees between clubs keeps your distances even. The LGW02 comes in three lofts rather than six, so this ladder will often pair it with an LGW01.

_pricing: The 'it costs $X because we sell direct' paragraph was removed 2026-07-31 (Cole). The price argument is made once, on the homepage's Why Lucky, and repeating it in the product description is the brochure voice.
